sources.title: OpenStreetMap: site and surrounding features
sources.note: ODbL. Site and building footprints, mapped monuments and facilities. No OSM edit dates are interpreted as construction dates.

sources.title: Independent facility reference
sources.note: Belfry reference confirms the facade tower; use OSM crossing footprint and a restrained bell-tower estimate. Forecourt fitted to Basilica Loop; grounds extent is estimated in OSM. Centennial Globe already mapped, not duplicated. All added positions, counts, widths and heights are schematic estimates fitted to OSM, not surveyed geometry. No satellite or Google Maps imagery was used. No timeline dates are inferred.

sources.title: Dominic McArthur: Peñafrancia Basilica Minore, 2014
sources.note: CC BY-SA 3.0. Independent facade photograph inspected for bell-tower, lawn, planting, trees and paving appearance; coordinates remain schematic OSM-based estimates.

sources.title: Draft surface placement audit
sources.note: Explicit paving overrides coarse ground fills only. Footprints are clipped to existing grounds and exclude mapped standing buildings and full-width carriageways. This geometry cleanup does not establish an otherwise unverified facility or current layout.
